title: Better Bows And Better Crossy Indicators
description: This Resource Pack Gives Bows/CrossBows A Good Indicator To Adjust Shooting time
body: A Resource Pack That Gives Both Bows And Crossbows Charge Indicators.This Resource Pack Will Show You When Charged Or Whilst Charging.Well For The Crossbow We Made It A Little Diffrent If You Put An Arrow Inside The Crossbow The Indicator Will Be Slightly Bigger As For If u Put A Firework Rocket.
